Role / Position Overview

We are looking for a production support analyst within the Citi Technology Support organization. This team manages the day-to-day availability of the applications and ensures issues or status updates are accurately communicated to business. The analyst will be working closely with colleagues in NAM region to ensure seamless 24 x 7 support of our applications. The analyst is also expected to build and enhance technical tools to help improve support operations. The incumbent should possess great multi-tasking skills to handle the fast-paced production environment. The ideal candidate should be technically astute, well organized, proactive, and comfortable in discussing issues with business and technical users at all levels.

This role will require the flexibility of working in shifts and providing weekend support as needed. The shift will vary between the hours of 9:00 am and 7:00 pm AU time.
